title: fix(spec,service-automation): the v18 stored preview lists page components on the retired API source and every refusal registerFlow makes after the parse
body:
Fixes #23317
Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What this does

`os migrate meta --stored` listed two families of stored rows as already on protocol while a v18 door refuses them. Both are now **refused and listed**, through the preview's existing TODO lines. Nothing is rewritten, on preview or on `--apply`, and `storedMigrationClean` does not move. No door accepts or refuses anything it did not before.

| item | shape | listed by | TODO id |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | a page component whose `data` prop binds the retired view-level API source: `object-grid`, `object-map`, `object-gantt`, `object-tree` | page, component and position; request headers withheld | `view-data-api-provider-retired` (the existing D3 entry, its scope extended) |
| 2 | every site `registerFlow` refuses in a stored flow the parse accepts: a text slot's template hole, a decision's `mode`, a malformed node or edge predicate, a plugin node's undeclared config key, an `api` flow with no secret | flow and site, in the check's own words | `registerFlow` (the refusing door: these sites have no step-18 entry of their own) |

## Public surface: Clause ②, yes (widening)

The card's prediction was `Clause-②: no` (the preview lists more, no door accepts more). That holds for every door. The diff also widens published outputs, the same class contract review record 6152721854 named for PR #23315, so this line is `yes (widening)`, and the changeset is `minor` for both packages:

- `ConversionTodoNotice.conversionId` (`@objectstack/spec`): may now name `registerFlow`, the refusing door, for a site no conversion and no D3 entry covers. Declared in its docblock.
- `IAutomationService.canonicalizeStoredFlow(...).todos?` (`@objectstack/spec`) and `AutomationEngine.canonicalizeStoredFlow(...).todos` (`@objectstack/service-automation`): now also carry each site flow registration refuses. Declared in the contract's docblock. No type changes.
- The `onTodo` sink of `applyConversions` (`@objectstack/spec`) now also receives a page component bound to the retired API source, under the existing D3 id.

Nothing narrows. No export name changes: `check:api-surface` is green and nothing was regenerated.

## Zone 2 assumptions, each measured

1. **The components: partly disproved.**
   - There are **four**, not two. `ComponentPropsMap` rows whose `data` is `ViewDataSchema`: `object-grid`, `object-map`, `object-gantt`, `object-tree`. `object-kanban`, `object-calendar` and `object-timeline` take a row array under `data` and refuse a provider object for its shape, never with this retirement's prescription.
   - **A stored page carrying one is not refused at rehydration.** `PageSchema.safeParse` and `getMetadataTypeSchema('page')` both accept the page, because `PageComponent.properties` is an open record. The door that refuses the binding is the component-props gate (`validateComponentProps` in `@objectstack/lint`). It is declared `surfaces: CLI_ONLY`, so `os validate`, `os build` and `os lint` refuse it in source, and the save door and the boot do not.
   - So the TODO's fate sentence says what is true: the page still loads and saves, and the CLI refuses the binding in source. The ruling's listing stands as written.
   - **Extending the existing D3 entry is the truthful record, not a sibling entry.** It is one retirement: the same arm of the same schema, under the same ruling. The entry's `surface` / `replacement` / `reason` / `acceptanceCriteria` now name the four components and the component-props gate.
   - **The judge is the door's own predicate.** Each stored component is judged by its own `ComponentPropsMap` row's `data` member, the one the component-props gate parses. It is listed only when that row refuses the binding with the prescription `ViewDataSchema` gives. No list of types is kept in step: a pin derives the four from `ComponentPropsMap` and holds the D3 entry's and the detector's `surface` text to them.
2. **The whole validation: holds, with one deviation from the Zone 3 route.**
   - `canonicalizeStoredFlow` was `registerFlow`'s first half: convert, parse, cycle check, region validation. The four registration checks (`validateNodeConfigKeys`, `validateDecisionModes`, `validateFlowExpressions`, `validateApiTriggerSecret`) ran only inside `registerFlow`, and each threw.
   - Measured on a probe at base `688a39d77`. Canonicalize passed, and `registerFlow` refused: a decision `mode: 'bogus'`, a malformed node predicate, a braced edge predicate, an `api` flow with no secret, and a notify `title` on the single-brace dialect or with an unknown formatter. A builtin's undeclared key and #23260's value arm (`get_record` `limit: '{x}'`) are refused inside `FlowSchema.parse`. So `canonicalizeStoredFlow` throws them, and the stored pass already reports the row `failed` with the parse's words.
   - **Deviation from Zone 3:** the checks cannot run from a module-scope function. They read the live engine: the action registry (plugin node `configSchema`), the trigger binding and its credential channel (`resolveSecret`), and the object-schema resolver. So the shared list is an instance method.
   - Each check now **returns** its refusal (the exact message it threw, plus its sites) instead of throwing. `registrationChecks()` is the one ordered list. `registerFlow` iterates it and throws the first refusal, so the same flows are refused with byte-identical messages. `canonicalizeStoredFlow` runs the same list and lists every site. A check added to that list later is listed with no second change.
   - The listing never throws: a check that throws instead of refusing is listed as one site at the flow. It runs only when `todos` is first read, once. So the save door, a package duplication and the sync's held-flow comparison (`holdsFlowDefinition` in `plugin.ts`), which read `parsed` / `storable` only, do no more work than before.
   - The schema-aware advisory pass (logged, never thrown) runs for registration only, so the doors that canonicalize log nothing new.
3. **No double listing: holds, and dedupe is needed.** A value-slot `{…}` site is refused by both the spec detector (D3 id) and `validateFlowExpressions`. Registration sites carry stack paths spelled as the conversion walk spells them (`flows[0].nodes[1].config.body.nodes[0].config.title`), and a site a chain TODO already names is skipped. Ablation A4 below: without the skip, the existing #23269 engine pin goes red.
4. **The report: holds; the line names the door.** A step-18 refused shape keeps its D3 id. A registration refusal has no step-18 entry, so its line reads `TODO registerFlow: SOURCE left as stored at PATH — No conversion rewrites it, and registerFlow refuses it: left as stored, the flow is not registered at boot and never runs. Flow NAME, WHERE: the check's message`. Here `SOURCE`, `PATH`, `NAME` and `WHERE` are placeholders. `from` shows the source text, the key, or the declared value. For the `api` secret, it shows only a blank string or `null`, so no secret is printed.

## Where it lands, and why outside the claim's file surface

The claim's surface was taken whole: `refused-shapes.ts` and its test, the D3 entry, `engine.ts`, `stored-migration.ts` (docblocks only) and one changeset. Outside it:
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/types.ts` and `packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`: docblocks only. They declare the widened domain and content above.
- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-error-vocabulary.ts`: one `foreign-vocabulary` row. `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` refuses any unclassified site that stamps `OS_METADATA_CONVERSION_TODO`, and the engine now builds that TODO. The row sits beside the `apply.ts` row and has the same reasoning. The file is read by the gate and by a test, and it is not in runtime's `dist`.
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`: the `--stored` table. Its row said each TODO names a step-18 entry and that the parse or the boot refuses the row, and both would have become false. It now lists both families, each with its fate.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/config-unknown-keys.test.ts`: one pin called the private `validateNodeConfigKeys` and expected a throw. It now reads the returned refusal.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.stored-migration.test.ts`: one preview pin for a page row.
- Not touched: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (fenced for PR #23345). The stored pass already reads `flowResult.todos ?? []`, so no edit there was needed.

## Pins

- **Item 1** (`refused-shapes.test.ts`, 14 new):
  - each of the four components is listed once at `pages[0].regions[0].components[0].properties.data`, naming the page, the component and its position, with the fate and the prescription; the row is not rewritten;
  - reach: a component nested in a `page:tabs` panel, and one in a slot;
  - no credential: headers are withheld;
  - **negative controls**, none listed: the `object` and `value` providers, `object-kanban` (a row-array `data`), a custom type with no props row, and the governed `dataSource` element binding;
  - **door agreement, both directions:** the listed set equals the props rows whose `data` refuses the binding with the prescription;
  - the fate holds: `PageSchema` accepts the page, and each row refuses the binding;
  - the D3 entry and the detector name the four.
  - `metadata-protocol`: the preview lists the page row `skipped` with its TODO, without the header. An `object` provider page counts as `canonical`. `--apply` writes nothing.
- **Item 2** (`canonicalize-stored-flow.test.ts`, 23 new):
  - eight refused flows, one per check (two text-slot shapes, a text slot in a loop body, a decision mode, a node predicate, an edge predicate, a plugin node's undeclared key, an `api` flow with no secret). Each is listed under `registerFlow` at its site, in the check's words, and `registerFlow` refuses it with the same words;
  - **negative controls:** the same eight on protocol list nothing and register;
  - **door agreement, both directions:** over the corpus, a flow is listed exactly when `registerFlow` refuses it;
  - several checks in one flow are all listed, in `registerFlow`'s order, and `registerFlow` still throws the first;
  - dedupe: a braced filter operand plus a single-brace title gives one D3 TODO and one `registerFlow` TODO;
  - a parse refusal (#23260's value arm) throws from `canonicalizeStoredFlow` as from `registerFlow`;
  - nothing is rewritten: `storable` is the input reference;
  - laziness: reading `parsed` / `storable` / `conflicts` runs no check, and `todos` runs them once;
  - no new logs: the advisory pass logs at `registerFlow` and not at `canonicalizeStoredFlow`.

## Verification

At `HEAD` `ac768f1d5` unless a line names another commit. `origin/main` was merged at `ac768f1d5`: 5 commits, none under `packages/spec`. `service-automation`'s `notify-node.ts` changed there, so that suite re-ran after the merge.

- Build: the closures of `@objectstack/service-automation^...`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol^...` and `@objectstack/runtime^...` (turbo, 30 of 30 tasks), then `@objectstack/spec` again; every `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date". No tracked file moved.
- `typecheck`, exit 0 each: `@objectstack/spec` (test layer held), `@objectstack/service-automation` (after the merge), `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/runtime`.
- Tests:
  - `@objectstack/service-automation`, the whole suite after the merge: 185 files, 2481 tests, exit 0.
  - `@objectstack/spec` `local` project in four locked runs: 102 files / 2735 tests, 170 / 5918, 310 / 9524 (+1 todo), and 88 / 2245. That is 670 files, the whole project (729 test files minus the 59 `repo` ones). All passed, at `706df2da0`; no spec file changed after it.
  - `@objectstack/spec` `test:repo`: 59 files, 1011 tests, exit 0, at `706df2da0`.
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: `protocol.stored-migration`, `protocol.flow-canonicalizer` and `protocol.save-flow-canonicalization`, 80 tests, exit 0. This is a declared narrowing: the package's code is unchanged (docblocks only), and CI runs the suite.
  - `@objectstack/runtime`: `error-envelope.conformance.test.ts` (the test that imports the vocabulary file), 53 tests, exit 0. Also a narrowing: runtime's code is unchanged.
- **Ablations**, one-shot, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode under the lock. Every anchor went 1 to 0, and every restore was proven: blob equal to `HEAD`, empty `git diff HEAD`. The spec and engine pins import their subject by relative path, so no `dist` leg was needed.
  - A1, the page-component judge made to return nothing: 7 failed, 38 passed, predicted red. The four listings, reach, the credential pin and door agreement failed; the five negative controls and two text pins stayed green.
  - A2, the props-row judge skipped (any API binding listed): 3 failed, 42 passed. `object-kanban`, the custom type and door agreement failed. This is the proof that the row is the judge.
  - A3, the registration listing removed from `canonicalizeStoredFlow`, re-run on the final lazy form: 13 failed, 21 passed. Every listing pin failed; the on-protocol controls, the parse-throw pin and the log pin stayed green.
  - A4, the per-site dedupe removed (final form): 2 failed, 32 passed. The dedupe pin and the existing #23269 "exactly one TODO" pin failed.
- Lint, a measured narrowing, not `pnpm lint`:
  - `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 13 changed files gave 13 entries. 11 were linted, with 0 errors and 0 rule warnings. eslint itself ignores the changeset and `cli.mdx` ("File ignored").
  - Invariance: `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 114 commands at `ac768f1d5`, with no stale-tree warning. Each ran with its exit code recorded before any pipe.
  - First pass: 112 exited 0. `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: an unbuilt `client-react`, and 30 unbuilt packages).
  - Both exited 0 once `turbo run build` filled their prerequisites (35 of 35 and 74 of 74 tasks, cached).
  - Reconcile: "✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 114 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 114 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 114 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)."
  - On the way, `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` caught one real finding: the engine's TODO stamp was unclassified. The vocabulary row above fixes it.

## Serial note: #23316

#23316 (branch `claude/issue-23316-refused-flow-runtime-state`, no PR yet) edits `engine.ts`, `plugin.ts` and `contracts/automation-service.ts`. `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/claude/issue-23316-refused-flow-runtime-state` gave exit 0 and tree `5069a5cc8` (no conflict), at this head and that branch's `2b84fe555`.
- That branch imports a type named `FlowRegistrationRefusal` into `engine.ts`, so this branch's internal types are named `RegistrationCheckRefusal` / `RegistrationCheckSite`. None of the identifiers this diff adds appears on that branch.
- This diff does not touch `plugin.ts`, the cold-boot bind, `withdrawFlow`, or what `registerFlow` does after its checks.
- **Whichever of the two PRs reaches the queue second merges `main` and re-runs the automation suite and the contract gates.** A joint typecheck of the merged tree was not measured here.

## Acceptance notes

- **The retired API binding still works on a stored page at runtime.** The component-props gate is CLI-only by its declared `surfaceReason` ("Gating rule held off the runtime door pending the crossing discipline … Crossing is its own rollout card"). The save door and the boot accept a page component whose `data` carries `provider: 'api'` with `headers`. At objectui `origin/main` `72594f29`, `resolveDataSource` still builds an `ApiDataSource` from such a config (`ObjectGantt.tsx` routes through it). So a stored page keeps sending the request as stored, headers included, until the row is rewritten. This PR lists those pages and does not change a door. It is reported as a finding.
- The prescription the component-props gate prints at a component's `data` says `view.data.provider`, because it is `ViewDataSchema`'s own text. This is wording only, and its carrier is the retirement's owner.
- Cost: when a caller reads `todos`, the stored pass runs registration's checks once per flow row. Nothing else pays for them.
